name: AI Regulation — License for Models
description: A government proposes strict AI licensing; tech, researchers, workers and civil-rights groups clash. Good for testing polarization.
seed_text: A government proposes strict new regulations on artificial intelligence, requiring licenses for large models. Tech companies warn the rules will stifle innovation and drive startups abroad. Researchers are split: some welcome safety rules, others fear overreach. Workers worry AI will replace their jobs regardless. A prominent CEO said "over-regulation will hand leadership to our rivals". A safety researcher praised the plan as "long overdue". Civil rights groups support transparency rules. Online opinion is sharply divided.
